# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c23 P27](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0027)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen area / St. Brendan's Island harbor region  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; host for summer lodgers and farm landlord  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna is described as an exceptionally stunning woman resembling her mother physically, with high self-respect, ivory-like marble arms, and hair that glistens like fire set against golden light. She retains a striking, goddess-like figure and presence. She routinely wears cheap cream-colored cotton voile dresses accented with a splash or belt of crimson, stating she never feels content without a flash of red.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c23 P27](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0027), [v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028)_

## Personality

In her childhood, Lorna was an intelligent, cheerful, warm, ambitious, and deeply affectionate girl loved by everyone. Tragedies and an unwanted marriage altered her public demeanor to an aloof, proud, and reserved state, erecting a protective wall between herself and others while remaining unyieldingly loyal to her family. Despite heavy isolation and living through years of hardship, she possesses a passionate, resilient nature, extreme self-respect, and deep quiet devotion.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c11 P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

## Traits

- Ambitious and highly intelligent  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Fiercely loyal to family  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Proud and reserved  <sub>[v4 c11 P29](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0029), [v4 c11 P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039)</sub>
- Enjoys wearing splashes of crimson  <sub>[v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

- Academically gifted, completing two years of study in one year at Regent's Academy  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Qualified and experienced local schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Goals

- Originally strived to earn money as a teacher to attend Wexcombe College  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Protect her mother from losing her home  <sub>[v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Faithfully care for her incapacitated companion  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## History

After completing two years of studies in a single year at Regent's Academy, Lorna became a joyful and ambitious schoolteacher at the Glen school. That summer, Rufus Vane sought her hand in marriage, but she repeatedly rejected him. However, when Rufus threatened to have his father foreclose on the Ainslie family farm, Lorna sacrificed her own happiness and married Rufus to spare her mother from distress. Following her mother's death a year later and Rufus's departure on the Four Sisters, Lorna remained isolated on the Ainslie farm. After Captain Saul brought back a memory-lacking man identified as Rufus from Havana, Lorna faithfully nursed and cared for him for eleven long years, supporting herself by leasing her farm to John Ward and hosting occasional summer lodgers. She built a warm friendship with Miss Winifred Tolley and eventually with Nell Harcourt. Years later, when medical interest led to investigations of her companion's identity, it was revealed that her husband Rufus had actually died of yellow fever in Cuba, and the man she spent eleven years caring for was his lookalike cousin, Laurence Vane. Upon Laurence regaining his memory, Lorna traveled with him to the hospital to care for him while contacting his family in Nova Scotia.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 c32 P10](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0010), [v4 c32 P11](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie and Rose Kerr, inheriting traits from her Grandmother West
- Traumatized at age twelve by witnessing the tragic death of her four-year-old brother, Julian  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after he committed suicide on his wedding anniversary when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Inherited funds from Grandmother West to attend Regent's Academy  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>

## Affiliations

- Glen School — Schoolteacher  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Presbyterian Church — Devoted member in spirit  <sub>[v4 c11 P43](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0043)</sub>
